beats.say: If you were born the day GTA Five came out, you're thirteen now.
beats.footnote: GTA V launched 17 Sept 2013 on PS3 and Xbox 360

beats.say: And you're still four years too young for GTA Six's rating.
beats.footnote: ESRB: GTA VI is rated M (Mature 17+)

beats.say: That's how long this wait has been.
Four thousand, eight hundred and eleven days.
beats.label: days from GTA V to GTA VI

beats.say: But here's the part nobody talks about.
The gap between GTA games used to be one year. Then two. Then three and a half. Then over five. This one? Thirteen.
beats.footnote: Years between North American launches. Our math.

beats.say: A whole console generation came and went without a new GTA.
beats.footnote: PS4 and Xbox One era, 2013 to 2020: no new numbered GTA

beats.say: It was supposed to land in twenty twenty five. Then May twenty twenty six. Then November nineteenth.
beats.footnote: Rockstar Newswire: delays announced 2 May 2025 and 6 Nov 2025

beats.say: We are very sorry that this is later than you expected.
It's now the most preordered game in PlayStation Store history.
beats.footnote: PlayStation Blog, 10 Nov 2026. Xbox says the same for Microsoft Store.

beats.say: The first trailer pulled over ninety million YouTube views in a single day.
beats.footnote: Guinness World Records: 90,421,491 YouTube views in 24 hours (Dec 2023)

beats.say: That's about a thousand people pressing play, every second, for twenty four hours straight.
beats.label: views every second, for 24 hours

beats.say: Trailer two? Rockstar says four hundred seventy five million views, across every platform.
beats.label: Trailer 2 views in 24 hours
beats.footnote: Rockstar's own figure (May 2025), all platforms combined, not YouTube alone

beats.say: And now, it's seven days away.
beats.label: days to go

beats.say: So tell me. How old were you when GTA Five came out? I'll go first in the comments.
Follow. One number a day, all the way to launch.
